Axiom: Process depth is proportional to the declared SCALE: SCALE governs interview depth, the number of design alternatives explored, and the weight of the verification tail. SCALE becomes binding only after operator confirmation — the router proposes a default, the operator confirms or corrects it; a silently self-assessed scale is void. The confirmed value is input to the current authoring owner only. Durable requirements never depend on recovering SCALE from a session file.
